Recepte, v katerih ni skrivnosti, in znanje, ki ga zapišemo v naše knjige. Vse delamo tudi zato, da bomo lahko delili še naprej in še več. Delati dobro tudi iz nas dela boljše ljudi. In ljudje smo bistvo vsega … DOBRI LJUDJE. Vsi, ki si rečemo ekipa in ki dan za dnem v naših restavracijah iz vrhunskih sestavin in idej pripravljamo najboljše za vas in vaše zadovoljstvo. In naši dobavitelji, izjemni in unikatni. Ustvarjamo skupaj z njimi, s strastjo in brez skrivnosti. Iskrenost med nami, njimi in vami je največ, kar si želimo in kar lahko ponudimo. DOBRA HRANA. Da je le okusna in dobra, po možnosti lokalna, vselej sveža in preprosta. Potem pravimo, da je poštena. Z veseljem vam pojasnimo, od kod izvirajo sestavine, zakaj smo izbrali prav te in kako smo jih začarali v slastno jed. Nekatere vam tudi ponudimo, da boste čarovnijo lahko preizkusili še doma.

Around vertical atrium with a central staircase, the structure of the hotel is visible: in the basement wine cellar stores and kitchen creates our gourmand treasures and goods, reception desk, restaurant and bar on the ground floor invites and hosts visitors and our hotel guests, to whom are available 20 rooms on three floors and a spacious terrace with an outdoor infinity pool. The design of Vander Urbani Resort is based on a game of three-dimensional patterns, of carefully chosen materials and reflections, of which the guest becomes a part of the interior. The interior is based as a continuous line flowing from one building to another and seduces with spectacular views which are completed with a remarkable sighting of the “Ljubljanica” river, the old city and the Ljubljana castle. The external an internal renovation was designed by SADAR + VUGA together with the owners. A 24 hour reception desk is available for our guests, we also offer free Wi-Fi. Indulge yourself with yoga, or a massage. All bathrooms offer Molton Brown Cosmetics. We offer a perfect sleep with Frette bedding and with a glove fitting exceptional mattresses… A “Wish Box” can be found in every room. Ecological awareness is not just a fashion statement for us. It’s a way of life and business. Our Vander restaurant is a special experience offering a unique breakfast, as well as “Deep dish” lunches and a la cart dinner. The most exquisite ingredients from Slovenia are used by by our culinary chefs with his endless inspiration. The wine cellar of the Vander restaurant is a real treasure of authentic wines especially from Slovenia and Australia. Exclusive

Name: Eco Resort Network

As a result, we delight in bringing people together in this field - to further collaboration, discussion and learning. We combine a rigorous and inspiring conference programme with excursions, networking meals and more to create meaningful connections. Our annual boutique networking events have been held in Slovenia (2022), Montenegro (2023) and Mauritius (2024), with our fourth event to be held in Greece in May 2025. Members of the network can get access to our events, reports and publications and can contact us for advice on connections they want to make.

Name: Bistro & Rooms Pri Karlu - Ex Hiša Budja
Company description: Boutique, family run bistro & rooms, where people have been coming as guests and leaving as friends since 1967.

Name: Židana Marela d.o.o.
Company description: Židana Marela was born when a few Slovenian guides experienced a typical Greek evening program and we thought to ourselves, why not do this in Slovenia? Once we returned to Ljubljana we launched the Traditional Slovenian evenings and later formed Židana Marela, meaning “the jolly umbrella”. This new formed company allowed each of us to play to our strengths: Tomaž with his myriad of ideas & love of music, Luka with his passion for photography and Miha’s expertise in business and public relations. Once we got rolling, an explosion of new ideas and new connections allowed us to expand our offerings and our team. Dragana, previously a tour operator for 10 years, wanted a chance to show off Slovenia and joined us to work on incoming tourism. Andrew, an American with an insatiable taste and curiosity for the Balkans, was brought into the fold, relocating all the way from Seattle. And the energy from Zidana has continued to attract others wanting to work with Zidana. We now offer many specialized travel products: from traditional Slovenian evenings and culture shows to photography tours, food & wine tours from stag parties to short trips and we’re still expanding.

Name: Rogaška Resort - Grand Hotel Rogaška****superior - Rogaška Slatina - Since 1912
Company description: Located in the heart of Rogaška Slatina, facing a magnificant park, the Grand Hotel Rogaška is a perfect example of timeless architectural class. With 194 historic rooms, every guests is transported back to the times of Princess Sissi (Elisabeth of Austria), Franz Joseph and of charming evening concertos performed by musician Liszt. Times may change, but our dedication to upholding the charms and standards of this building remain the same. Our highly personalized 24-hour service, combined with authentic, elegant surroundings embodies a home away from home for our guests. Over the years, our staff have built an unrivalled level of reliability, trust and connection with our guests – a connection we continue to uphold. The Grand Hotel Rogaška is a hotel that soothes and invigorates the body and mind. Natural mineral water Donat Mg, which dates back some 8000 years has proven healing. Spring water in the depths (between 280 and 600 meters below ground) enriched minerals from dissolving the rock ( magnesium, calcium, sulfates, hydrogen carbonates ) and other elements (CO2) , which relieves or prevents many diseases and protect our health. Due to its chemical composition, physical properties, balneological knowledge and medical findings in Rogaska Slatina for more than 100 years used in therapeutic and preventive purposes. It is characterized by an extremely high mineral content is more than 13 g of dissolved minerals per liter (with CO2), of which the only magnesium more than 1000 mg / l calcium , around 300 mg/l, and contains many other health-beneficial elements and compound.

Name: NEU Residences
Company description: NEU Residences predstavlja novo ikono bivanja, ki je ustvarjena v skladu s potrebami sodobnega človeka. NEU je poslovno-počitniško-stanovanjski hibrid s 55 stanovanji s storitvami. NEU Residences is the new ideal of living designed to meet modern people’s needs. NEU is a hybrid with 55 serviced apartments that cater to business and leisure travelers and guests on an extended stay.

Company description: Proky helps hotels, restaurants and their suppliers to save time, costs and food waste.  Order from all your suppliers at once - just Proky it!

Name: Urban Boutique Hotel 4* Ljubljana
Company description: Urban boutique hotel is located in the city center of Ljubljana.  It’s within walking distance of many of the top attractions of the city.  Ljubljana is known for its green spaces and the hotel is located next to one of them- next to Argentinski park and very close to the famous Tivoli city park.  You can easily walk to the castle, Triple bridge, Ljubljanica river and Franciscan church. You will receive a warm welcome at check in by friendly English speaking staff.  Whatever you are in Ljubljana for, it’s very likely you’ll be able to walk there from the hotel.  The staff will be happy to provide you with a map.   The guest rooms are spacious.  Enjoy relaxing on the bed or sofa whilst watching the huge selection of cable channels. In the Urban hotel you’ll find a simple yet modern place to easily access your luggage from.  To give you a little inspiration of what to do in the city, there is some art work of the cities attractions in the rooms and around the hotel. The hotel provides you with a cell phone to help you in the city.  You can make free local calls and access the internet from anywhere in the country.  Ljubljana and the Urban hotel could be your base as you make day trips and the phone would be your perfect companion.  The best part of the Bathroom is the walk in rainfall shower.  Make note of the towel heaters.  There’s no better way to end your shower experience than drying yourself with a warm towel.  You’ll find all the amenities you require in the bathroom, such as soap, shampoo, vanity kit, hairdryer and magnifying mirror. For the breakfast buffet you may help yourself to freshly prepared food.  A unique part of the breakfast is the smoothie.  It’s good to start your day off with some vitamins.   Remember the staff are there to make sure you enjoy your stay in Ljubljana.  They will go out of their way to ensure this happens.  Any requests or doubts you have should be shared with them.

Name: Veladrion Resort
Company description: Veladrion Resort is positioned beneath mount Velebit where the river Little Gacka flows into the Adriatic Sea. Experience a truly personalized luxurious approach in the blue-green nature environment. Veladrion Resort comprises of three beautiful Villas, nestled in Croatian park of the nature.  For a memorable time we offer a diverse range of activities on the Adriatic Sea like night fishing or exploring the nearby islands, to the inland activities on the sport fields inside the Veladrion Resort or the off-road Jeep drive through the attractive terrain of Velebit National park. Veladrion Resort is part of Zubak Group.

Name: Hotel In Gostilna Florjanckov Hram
Company description: The hotel offers many amenities for tourists and business travellers alike. Our hotel rooms, furnished with simplicity and taste, welcome you with all the comfort you'd expect. Our service is completed with Wi-Fi, free parking and a traditional restaurant, everything you need for a perfect stay in Ljubljana.

Name: Barbo Palace
Company description: Welcome to The Barbo Palace, built and designed by architect Matija Persky in 1755 for Count Jost Vajkard von Barbo. Its unique Baroque façade and interior courtyard, along with the only double staircase in Ljubljana, make it one of the most intriguing historical buildings in Ljubljana. The current owner recently decided to convert this historic palace into a boutique hotel, thus making its splendid views available to all its guests. With its 13 Apartments and 3 Hotel Rooms welcomes guests with remarkable European Flair and heartwarming service. Its prime location and wonderful furnishings make it the perfect place to stay for a family trip, a business trip, or a romantic getaway.

Name: Pure Travel
Company description: Pure travel is a travel agency, located in Slovenia. Our speciality is organizing sport preparations in Slovenia (for football teams, wolleyball teams, handball teams, basketball teams, waterpolo teams, tennis). We are a specialist for halal services in Slovenia.

Name: Hotel Marina Izola
Company description: Hotel Marina stands in the middle of a small fishing town called Izola, where the spirit of the Mediterranean Sea melts with the modern touch of the litoral paradise. The hotel offers 100 beds in 52 rooms, the majority of them has a view on the Adriatic Sea. Our restaurant's specialties taste even better while sitting on the terrace and enjoying a gentle sea breeze. Thai massage and spa treatments from the best Thai hotels are also available at the Hotel Marina. Guests can choose from a traditional Thai massage, a massage with fragrant oils, an anti-cellulite massage, a foot reflexology massage and many more. You can also spend a romantic evening with your partner in the privacy of the jacuzzi and sauna with candles, a glass of sparkling wine and soft music. T: 00386 (0)5 66 04 100 E: info@hotelmarina.si

Name: WELLNESS CENTER CASANOVA SRL
Company description: L' Hotel Casanova è situato nel cuore della Val D' Orcia, gioiello incastonato nell'incantevole cornice dei colli toscani che, dal 2004, vanta la propria presenza all'interno della prestigiosa World Heritage List. Quando si varca la soglia dell'Hotel è immediatamente tangibile un'atmosfera particolare, calda, intima e avvolgente. Un luogo dove il dettaglio, curato con passione, impreziosisce il territorio circostante già location di numerose e fortunate pellicole cinematografiche come quella de "Il Gladiatore". Al residence Casanova hai la possibilità di vivere un'esperienza completa, dove il piacere della tavola toscana si mescola all'incanto di un panorama mozzafiato.   La struttura dispone di camere adatte a tutte le esigenze: Country, Coppia Comfort, Doppia Superior, Junior Suite, Suite Superior e Country Superior Suite. L' Hotel ha un particolare occhio di riguardo anche per i nostri amici a quattro zampe, ospiti graditi all'interno della struttura.

Name: Hotel Kras
Company description: The luxuriously decorated Hotel Kras in Postojna, close to the world-famous Postojna Cave, offers well-equipped, elegant accommodation with magnificent views of the Nanos Plateau and the town. All air-conditioned rooms and apartments have panoramic windows that offer views of the city and the surrounding mountains. There are many convenient services offered by the Hotel Kras. The garage is under video surveillance. Sip your coffee in the coffee room and enjoy your rich breakfast with homemade bread and cakes from the hotel's own bakery. Mouth-watering homemade goodies and warm beverages complete the offer.

Name: ONE66 Hotel
Company description: “Friendship isn’t a big thing, it’s a million little things.”  We want you to find and enjoy all the little things that hotel One66 has to offer. We are the rebels of the traditional hospitality industry – more than just a place to sleep. Our vision was to create a boutique hotel that brings people together through art, music, and events. The ethos that we pursue is to provide an affordable hotel experience without sacrificing on style and entertainment. We aim to be different, unique, rebellious, and spontaneous…and we also bring freshly oven-baked pizza to your room…WHY? Well because we can! The offer is perfectly designed to tailor to the need of a modern traveler. The hotel is designed for a short stay as per longer stay too. One66 is a home away from home, a haven for holiday and business travelers who want to live, work and socialize with like-minded people. A vibrant mix of sleek, modern guestrooms, apartments, and urban glamping containers – we have a selection of rooms suitable for anyone and everyone. Guest are welcome to use smart electronic gadgets, dimmable lighting, 42-inch TV, local artworks, and astonishing interior design features. The heart, the pièce de resistance, of the hotel is a space named “The Loft” – a spacious and lively multifunctional communal space with its restaurant, bar, and lounge that provides entertainment on site. We are located in Ljubljana, with easy access to a highway and other local sights and interesting areas. We are just a short 5 min drive from the city center, excellent bus routes will provide easy access too.  You can also use our bikes, e-scooters to get you around. Should you decide to spend a bit more time inside the hotel, we offer a fully equipped gym area, showroom with its own PlayStation 5 console, and a conference hall with its basketball court. Should you feel a bit artsier, we have a permanent art exhibition and a local market shop available for you. Come and be our friend!

The design and comfort of the house merge with a passionate team, committed to provide the best personalized hotel and restaurant stories for all guests.

Company description: Za vas organiziramo teambuilding, izlet ali strokovno ekskurzijo v Beli krajini, neposredno ob reki Kolpi. Bela krajina je znana po svojih odličnih vinih, lokalni gastronomiji in športnih aktivnostih na reki Kolpi. Skupaj pripravimo program, ki ustreza vašim željam. Rafting je odlična izbira saj je Kolpa ena najbolj čistih in toplih rek v Evropi. Ob reki pripravimo piknik kosila ali večerne zabave za podjetja. Od jedi ne sme manjkati Belokranjska pogača, pečen jagenjček in ostale lokalne dobrote. Teambuilding igre so tekmovalne ampak izjemo zabavne, preizkusite se v Belokranjskem mnogoboju, Olimpijskih '84 ali Drašičkem izzivu. Za zaključek je vinska degustacija prava izbira. Poskrbimo tudi za nočitve v hotelu v glampingih ob reki Kolpi.

Name: AIRTH - Alliance For Innovators And Researchers In Tourism And Hospitality
Company description: Innovation is a cornerstone of economic development. Interest in tourism and hospitality innovation comes and goes. In recent years there has been a constant, yet small, stream of research in this area. The goal of AIRTH is to work with interested institutions to arrange for conferences, events and projects to put a permanent spotlight on innovation in tourism & hospitality management. These activities should be opportunities for scholars and practitioners alike to learn from each other and to initiate collaborative work. In other words: this should be fun!

Company description: Boxa Travel is an innovative platform that combines sustainable tourism with blockchain technology and cryptocurrency.  The platform is designed to enable travelers to find and book eco-friendly accommodations while also providing incentives for hosts and guests to engage in environmentally conscious practices.

Name: Camp Korita
Company description: Camp Korita is family business which promotes dwelling in the middle of the unspoilt nature. Peter and his family welcome all of those bringing their own tents and sleeping bags, ready to enjoy traditional camping. On the other hand the glamping site of the Camp Korita offers all the cozzines of glamping resort to snuggle up at night for relaxed dinners and campfires. Small camp next to emerald river enables a boutique experience of camping and glamping. Hospitality is one of the highest priorities. Whether you need an information about outdoor activities, directions for your next trip or the best option to have a breakfast, the staff of Camp Korita will be more than happy to assist you. One of the essential visions of the camp is to keep surrounding nature area preserved as it is. Camp Korita is therefore developing environment friendly as possible. The evidence of camp’s sustainability are wooden constructions of shepherd's huts, villas and chalets perfectly blending with landscape.

Name: Peterc Vineyard Estate
Company description: The upscale Peterc Vineyard Estate, overlooking a 200 year-old vineyard plot, lies perched atop Brda wine country, where the Mediterranean meets the Alps. The area offers the best of both worlds in an endless array of exciting things to do, including dining at the finest gourmet restaurants or authentic local osterias, touring local award–winning wineries, indulging in outdoor activities in the region’s breathtaking scenery and exploring its amazing history. Our exclusive establishment welcomes guests age 16 and over. Easily accessible at just 30min from Trieste airport or a short 90 minutes from Venice Marco Polo, Treviso and Ljubljana airports. The Peterc Vineyard Estate offers a selection of bright and elegant accommodations situated in a peaceful and authentic setting. Our vineyard estate in the Brda hills is designed for the adult traveler seeking a tranquil, relaxing and indulgent atmosphere. With our carefully appointed rooms, luxury amenities, and beautiful views arching across the vineyards and olive groves all the way to the Adriatic Sea, you won’t find a more romantic place to stay in Brda than at the Peterc Vineyard Estate in Kojsko. Choose from our delicious a la carte menu with complimentary sparkling wine. Name: Hotel Plesnik
Company description: The Plesnik family has lived in the Logar Valley for over 700 years. Agriculture and forestry were the main occupations of our ancestors, and in the early 20th century, tourism joined. From the very beginning, Plesnik Hotel has been committed to sustainability and ecotourism and the sustainable use of resources. We have taken a number of measures to raise awareness among our guests as well as suppliers, to ensure that pristine nature can be enjoyed for generations to come. The unique nature of the Logar Valley Landscape Park is breathtakingly beautiful and to preserve it, we need to act in a sustainable way. Our lasting commitment is made up of several segments, with the common thread being the care for nature, local traditions and the local population. At all levels, we strive to contribute to improving and preserving the quality of life and to provide our guests with an unforgettable stay at the hotel and unique experiences. Our commitment to sustainability is reflected in our choice of natural materials and the integration of local products and inhabitants into our story. We believe that everyone benefits from this: guests and locals alike. At the same time, we have reduced energy, taken care of the water and waste management through the renovation of our hotel, and with the efficient use of food in our restaurant we are also successfully implementing a zero-waste strategy.

Name: Hoteliers Inspiration

We concentrate on maximizing the potential of resources, relating to every aspect of the business but with a particular focus on employees, guests, and financial and quality aspects of the business. Over 25 years experience of working within the hospitality industry has given us the knowledge we need to share our expertise with you. We help companies to discover their Winning Ways, searching and finding a balance amongst four essential core aspects; Employees, Guests, Finance and Quality. Name: Betnava Hotel Maribor
Company description: Betnava hotel Maribor is a newer four-star hotel in Maribor in Slovenia. It is easily accessible and is the first hotel you bump into if you enter the city from the south artery. There are only 3 kilometres to the city centre in one and the green hill of Pohorje in the other way. This makes the hotel a popular accommodation for businessmen who want to relax after a hard working day. In front of the hotel there is a forest with Betnava castle, jogging path and Adventure Park. On the other side of the hotel you can find a big shopping centre. The hotel reception is opened 24/7. The parking area, where there is a video surveillance, is big enough to have parked several buses at the same time. Free Wi-Fi is available for the guests at the whole hotel area. There are 40 twin or queen bed rooms in the hotel. The hotel´s offer is rounded with two suites. Room are equipped with flat TV set, telephone, safe and mini bar; all hotel linen is natural and anti-allergic. Restaurant Betnava daily offers fresh and diverse buffet breakfast which combines the tastes and wishes of guests from different countries and cultures. Lunch or dinner can be done A la carte or as a self-serving buffet. In case of accommodating a group - meal times, menu´s and the way of serving the meals are adjusted to the customer. Hotels restaurant can take up to 70 persons. Hotel Betnava is adjusted to business tourism. Here you can find several business offices (for small business events) as well as big conference room which can take up to 120 persons. Hotel also offers wide selection of types of catering during the breaks. Our hotel offer completes the offer of quality massages, possibility of renting a private VIP sauna (with Turkish and Finnish sauna included), one of the biggest and most modern fitness centre in Slovenia, located in the hotel and a Coffee house with a big terrace.
